subject: Hosted evaluation: quickstart, prefetch & rate clarifications
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@novapay.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novapay.com
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted evaluation: quickstart, prefetch & rate clarifications

Hi Nora — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + a few asks so we can scope a hosted quickstart that matches Novapay's constraints.

Recap from our demo
- You want to start with a hosted evaluation (sandbox -> pilot) to validate model quality and latency.
- Primary flows: transactional fraud-check prompts (short) and merchant messaging generation (longer, templated).
- Expected payload mix: ~70% short prompts (~50–200 tokens), 30% long prompts (~800–1200 tokens).

Clarifying questions for scoping the hosted quickstart:
1) Traffic profile: can you confirm expected sustained RPS and peak concurrency for the pilot? earlier you mentioned a conservative 30–50 RPS but your internal doc hinted at higher bursts.
2) Endpoint needs: do you want separate endpoints for fraud vs. messages (recommended) or a single multi-model route?
3) Token limits: our hosted default is 4k token context; do you have any requests >4k or needs for streaming?
4) Data residency / compliance: you noted SOC2 + audit logs — we'll include SOC2 evidence and an ops runbook. If you require VPC/private deployment later, we can plan a migration (timebox: 4–8 weeks).

What we propose for an initial hosted quickstart (fast path)
- Sandbox endpoints provisioned in 48 hours with isolated prefix key.
- Default ratecaps: 100 concurrent connections, 200 RPS burst; token limit 4096.
- Prefetch/KV suggestions: enable prefix caching for templated messages to reduce token cost and improve latency.
- Deliverables: access to sandbox, quickstart checklist (attached), a 30-min onboarding call with infra in the first week.

Please reply with answers to (1)-(3) and any hard constraints (procurement timelines, required SLAs). I attached a lightweight checklist to help collect any legal/security asks.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0191

Attachments: hosted_quickstart_checklist.pdf
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@novapay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novapay.com
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: quickstart, prefetch & rate clarifications

Jordan — thanks for the follow-up and the checklist, very helpful. Answers inline below.

1) Traffic profile: for the pilot we can commit to an average of ~40 RPS with expected hourly peaks up to ~150 RPS during business spikes. Peak concurrency likely in the 80–120 range (short windows).
2) Endpoints: we'd prefer separate endpoints for fraud checks and for messaging. Fraud needs low-latency (p95 < 200ms if possible); messaging can tolerate higher latency.
3) Token limits: 4k context is fine for now; some merchant templates may push toward 5k with heavy metadata — we'd rather optimize templates than increase context if possible. Streaming is not required for the pilot.

Compliance: SOC2 Type II is a must before production; for the sandbox/pilot we can accept hosted with audit logs retained for 90 days. Procurement will want a statement of data retention and access controls.

Procurement timeline: procurement@novapay.com will start contract review next week; we may need a standard SOW and an initial quote.

Next step: can you propose a sandbox provisioning timeline and a time for the onboarding call?

Best — Nora
Nora Patel
Head of Product | Novapay
nora.patel@novapay.com | +1 212-555-0147
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@novapay.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@novapay.com
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 12:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: quickstart, prefetch & rate clarifications

Hi Nora — thanks for the clear answers, that traffic profile is helpful. A couple of concrete notes and a proposed timeline.

Runtime / rate guidance (hosted sandbox)
- Sandbox provisioning: we can stand up an isolated sandbox and API keys within 48 business hours after you sign the sandbox access agreement.
- Ratecaps: default sandbox limits are 100 concurrent connections / 200 RPS burst. Given your peak target of 150 RPS and concurrency up to ~120, we recommend a custom rate slice for the pilot (150 RPS steady, 250 RPS burst) — we can propose that in the SOW.
- Latency: for fraud route, we'll pin a smaller model variant and tune instance sizing — target p95 < 200ms for short prompts is feasible but we'll validate in the first week.
- Token limits & cost: 4096 context by default; if templates push >4k we suggest server-side template expansion + prefix caching to reduce token usage.

Operational asks
- We'll provide SOC2 evidence and a standard audit bundle for procurement; full Type II report may take time but we'll share interim artifacts.
- Logging: sandbox will include request-level traces and an ops dashboard (retention 90 days).

Timeline proposal
- Day 0: Access agreement signed (procurement).
- Day 1–2: Sandbox endpoints provisioned + API keys.
- Day 3–5: Integration smoke test (sample traffic and latency validation).
- Week 2: Internal readout and decision on pilot SLA/rate adjustments.

I'll attach a sample SOW line item for the custom rate slice and a short checklist for your procurement team (attached). If that works I can loop in Solutions Ops to draft a quote for procurement.

Cheers — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0224

Attachments: novapay_sla_req.xlsx
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@novapay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@novapay.com
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 10:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: quickstart, prefetch & rate clarifications

Thanks Ben — that timeline is reasonable. Procurement will review the SOW; procurement@novapay.com is copied.

We'd like to schedule the 30-min onboarding call on Tue 12/9 at 10:00am ET if that works for your team. During the call we'll validate the sandbox keys, confirm endpoint separation, and run a short latency smoke test.

Also, please include a single-page quote for the pilot (rate slice + 4 weeks of monitoring) we can attach to the SOW.

I'll await the SOW and the calendar invite.

Best — Nora
